column1: regress§Patients regress in the fourth week of the programme, and nine of the ten studies never followed them that long.§病人在项目第四周会**倒退**，而十项研究中有九项从未跟踪那么久。§re（回）+ gress（走，同 progress 前进）
regressive§The tax is regressive: the poorest quarter of households pay four times as much of their income.§这项税是**累退的**——最穷的四分之一家庭为此付出的收入比例高出四倍。§
regularly§The gauge was read regularly for forty years and then, after 1998, only when someone remembered.§这台仪表**定期**读取了四十年，1998 年之后就只在有人想起时才读。§
regulate§Nobody regulates the trade, and four attempts to write rules have died in the same committee.§没有人**监管**这个行业，四次立规尝试都死在同一个委员会。§reg（规则，同 rule 规则）
rehabilitation§Rehabilitation took nine months, and the four weeks of surgery are the only part anyone asks about.§**康复**花了九个月，而人们只问那四周的手术。§re（再）+ habilit（能力，同 ability 能力）
rehash§The report is a rehash of the 1994 review with four paragraphs about the internet added.§这份报告是 1994 年那次评估的**炒冷饭**，加了四段关于互联网的文字。§re（再）+ hash（剁碎）
rehearsal§The final rehearsal ran nine hours, and the performance itself lasted about forty minutes.§最后一次**排练**用了九小时，而演出本身约四十分钟。§
rehearse§They rehearsed the evacuation four times a year, and the one real evacuation took nine minutes.§他们每年**演练**四次疏散，而真正的一次疏散用了九分钟。§
reinforce§Every new study reinforces a conclusion the field reached, on much thinner evidence, in 1968.§每一项新研究都**强化**了这个领域 1968 年凭薄得多的证据得出的结论。§re（再）+ force（力量）
reintegrate§Reintegrating the four teams took longer than splitting them had, and cost about nine months.§把这四个团队**重新整合**花的时间比当初拆分还长，约九个月。§re（再）+ integrate（整合）
reiterate§She reiterated the point four times in nine minutes, and the minutes record it once.§她在九分钟里**重申**了这一点四次，而会议记录只写了一次。§re（再）+ iter（再次）
rejection§The rejection letter was four lines long, and the manuscript it turned down sold nine hundred thousand copies.§这封**退稿**信只有四行，而被它拒绝的稿子卖了九十万册。§
rejuvenate§Nine hundred pounds of new lighting rejuvenated a shop that had looked closed for four years.§九百英镑的新照明**焕新**了一家看着已关门四年的店铺。§re（再）+ juven（年轻，同 juvenile 少年的）
release§The department released the figures on a Friday evening, four hours before a public holiday.§这个部门在周五傍晚、公众假期前四小时**发布**了这些数字。§
relegate§The report was relegated to an appendix, and the four findings that mattered went unread.§这份报告被**降格**放进附录，四项要紧的发现无人阅读。§re（回）+ leg（派遣，同 delegate 代表）→ 打发到后面去
relevance§The relevance of the 1908 case was disputed for nine years and settled in about four minutes.§1908 年那桩案子的**相关性**被争论了九年，约四分钟就解决了。§re（再）+ lev（举起，同 elevate 抬起）→ 抬起来对照
relieve§Two extra staff relieved a ward that had run four nurses short for nine months.§两名增援人员**缓解**了一个九个月来缺四名护士的病区。§re（再）+ liev ← lev（轻，同 levity 轻浮）
relinquish§She relinquished the chair after nine years and stayed on the committee for another four.§她在九年后**放弃**了主席职位，又在委员会留了四年。§re（回）+ linqu（离开，同 delinquent 失职的）
relish§He relishes the difficult questions and answers the easy ones in about four words.§他**享受**难题，回答简单问题则大约只用四个词。§
relocate§The company relocated four hundred staff and lost nine of the eleven people it most wanted to keep.§公司**搬迁**了四百名员工，却失去了最想留下的十一人中的九个。§re（再）+ locate（定位）
reluctant§The most reluctant witness gave the clearest account, and it took nine months to persuade him.§最**不情愿的**证人给出了最清晰的陈述，而说服他花了九个月。§re（回）+ luct（挣扎，同 reluctance 勉强）
remedial§The remedial work cost four times the saving that caused it, which the report states in one line.§这项**补救**工程的花费是当初节省额的四倍，报告用一行说明了这点。§
remedy§There is no remedy in the contract, and the four affected suppliers have no way to recover anything.§合同里没有**补救办法**，四家受影响的供应商无从追回任何损失。§re（再）+ med（治疗，同 medicine 药）
reminiscence§Her reminiscence of the 1962 flood is the only first-hand account anyone has been able to find.§她对 1962 年那场洪水的**回忆**，是唯一能找到的第一手记述。§
reminiscent§The layout is reminiscent of a building four hundred miles away that the architect never mentioned.§这个布局**令人想起**四百英里外的一栋建筑，而建筑师从未提及。§re（再）+ minisc（记起，同 memory 记忆）
remiss§It would be remiss not to mention the four volunteers who did most of the actual work.§不提那四位做了大部分实际工作的志愿者会是**失职的**。§re（回）+ miss（送，同 mission 使命）→ 松手放掉了
remnant§The remnant of the wall is four metres long and is all that survives of a nine-hundred-year building.§这段**残存**的墙有四米长，是一栋九百年建筑仅存的部分。§re（再）+ man（留下，同 remain 保持）
remonstrance§The remonstrance was signed by nine residents and answered, four months later, with a form letter.§这份**抗议书**由九名居民签署，四个月后收到一封格式回信。§re（再）+ monstr（显示，同 demonstrate 证明）
remonstrate§She remonstrated with the driver for four minutes and then simply took his keys.§她跟司机**理论**了四分钟，然后干脆拿走了他的钥匙。§
remorseful§The remorseful letter arrived nine years late, and the person it was addressed to had died.§这封**充满悔恨的**信迟到九年，收信人已经去世。§re（再）+ mors（咬，同 morsel 小块）→ 反复啃噬内心
remuneration§The remuneration is modest and the hours are not, which explains a nine-percent annual turnover.§**报酬**不高而工时不短，这解释了百分之九的年流失率。§re（回）+ muner（礼物，同 munificent 慷慨的）
renew§They renewed the lease for four years and negotiated, in exchange, a rent freeze nobody expected.§他们**续签**了四年租约，作为交换谈成了一项无人预料的租金冻结。§re（再）+ new（新）
renewal§The renewal of the licence took nine months and required a document that had been abolished in 1994.§执照的**续期**花了九个月，还要求一份 1994 年就废止的文件。§
renounce§He renounced the claim in writing and, four years later, sued on exactly the same grounds.§他书面**放弃**了这项主张，四年后又以完全相同的理由起诉。§re（回）+ nounc（宣告，同 announce 宣布）
renovation§The renovation uncovered four earlier ceilings, and the oldest of them dated from about 1490.§这次**翻修**揭出四层更早的天花板，最老的一层约在 1490 年。§re（再）+ nov（新，同 novel 新奇的）
renowned§The renowned collection is, in fact, nine objects, and four of them are copies.§这批**著名的**藏品其实只有九件，其中四件是复制品。§re（再）+ nown ← nomin（名字，同 nominate 提名）
renunciation§The renunciation was formal, public, and, according to four letters he wrote afterwards, entirely insincere.§这次**弃绝**是正式而公开的，而据他事后写的四封信看，完全不是真心的。§
reparation§The reparations were paid over forty years and amounted, in the end, to about nine percent of the damage.§**赔偿**分四十年支付，最终约相当于损失的百分之九。§re（再）+ par（准备，同 prepare 准备）→ 修补回来
repeal§Parliament repealed the act in 1994, and four of its provisions were re-enacted, verbatim, in 1998.§议会 1994 年**废除**了这部法案，其中四条在 1998 年一字不改地重新立法。§re（回）+ peal ← appeal（呼吁）→ 叫回去
repel§The coating repels water for about four years and then does the opposite, which nobody tested for.§这层涂料**排斥**水约四年，之后效果相反，而这一点无人测试过。§re（回）+ pel（推，同 propel 推进）
repentance§His repentance was public and, according to his own accounts, four years in arriving.§他的**悔悟**是公开的，而据他自己所记，是四年后才到来的。§
repertory§The company's repertory is four plays, and it has performed nothing else since 1998.§这家剧团的**保留剧目**是四部戏，自 1998 年起没演过别的。§
repetitive§The work is repetitive rather than difficult, and the error rate quadruples after the ninth hour.§这项工作是**重复性的**而非困难的，错误率在第九小时后翻两番。§
replica§The replica is displayed and the original is in a drawer, which four visitors in ten find disappointing.§展出的是**复制品**，原件在抽屉里，十位访客中有四位觉得失望。§
replicate§Four laboratories failed to replicate the result, and the fifth found the effect was about a ninth as large.§四家实验室未能**重复出**这个结果，第五家发现效应约只有原来的九分之一。§re（再）+ plic（折叠，同 complicate 使复杂）
replication§Replication is the whole point, and about nine percent of published studies are ever replicated.§**可重复性**才是要害，而已发表研究中约百分之九曾被重复验证。§

reprehensible§The conduct was reprehensible by any ordinary standard and, under the rules as actually written, entirely permitted.§按任何寻常标准这种行为都**应受谴责**，而按实际写下的规则则完全被允许。§re（再）+ prehend（抓，同 apprehend 领会）→ 抓回来问罪
repress§The report was repressed for nine years and released, without comment, in a batch of four hundred documents.§这份报告被**压下**九年，随后在四百份文件的一批中无声发布。§re（回）+ press（压）
repressive§The repressive measures produced four years of quiet and, in the fifth, the largest protest in the country's history.§这些**高压**措施带来四年平静，第五年则爆发了该国史上最大的抗议。§
reprieve§The reprieve came nine hours before the deadline and lasted exactly four months, after which nothing had changed.§**缓期**在截止前九小时到来，恰好持续了四个月，之后一切照旧。§re（再）+ prise（抓，同 prison 监狱）→ 暂时松手
reproduce§The printer could not reproduce the blue, and four attempts produced four different greys.§印刷机无法**再现**那种蓝色，四次尝试出了四种不同的灰。§re（再）+ produce（生产）
reproduction§The reproduction hangs in the hall, and nine visitors in ten have never noticed the label.§这幅**复制品**挂在大厅，十位访客中有九位从未注意到标签。§
repudiate§The board repudiated an agreement that its own chair had signed, in public, only four months earlier.§董事会**否认**了自家主席仅四个月前当众签署的一份协议。§re（回）+ pud（羞耻，同 impudent 无耻的）→ 羞于承认
reputable§The most reputable firm in the field made the error, and four smaller ones caught it.§这个领域最**有声望的**公司犯了这个错，四家更小的公司发现了它。§
requisition§The requisition took nine signatures, and by the time it cleared the equipment had been discontinued.§这份**申领单**要九个签名，等它批下来，设备已经停产。§re（再）+ quisit（寻求，同 require 需要）
rescind§The council rescinded the decision four days later, after nine hundred people signed a petition.§在九百人签署请愿书后，议会四天后**撤销**了这个决定。§re（回）+ scind（切，同 scissors 剪刀）→ 一刀割掉
researcher§The researcher who found the discrepancy was nineteen and had been asked to check the arithmetic.§发现这处出入的**研究员**十九岁，任务只是核对算术。§
resemble§The two cases resemble each other in nine particulars and differ in the one that decides both.§这两桩案子在九个细节上**相似**，而在决定两者的那一点上不同。§re（再）+ simil（相似，同 similar 相似的）
resentment§The resentment lasted nine years and began with a decision neither of them now remembers clearly.§这份**怨恨**持续九年，起于一个如今两人都记不清的决定。§re（再）+ sent（感觉，同 sense 感觉）
residual§The residual risk is small and real, and the report quantifies it at about four in a million.§**残余**风险小而真实，报告将其量化为约百万分之四。§resid（留下，同 reside 居住）
resilience§The resilience of the network was tested in 2011, and nine of its eleven links survived.§这个网络的**韧性**在 2011 年受到检验，十一条链路中有九条挺住了。§re（回）+ sil ← sal（跳，同 salient 突出的）→ 弹回去
resilient§The most resilient crop in the trial yielded least in a good year and most in the four bad ones.§试验中最**耐逆的**作物在好年份产量最低，在四个坏年份产量最高。§
resistant§The strain is resistant to four of the five drugs, and the fifth is unavailable in most of the country.§这个菌株对五种药中的四种**有抗性**，而第五种在国内多数地方买不到。§re（回）+ sist（站立，同 assist 协助）→ 站着顶住
resolute§She was resolute about the deadline and flexible about everything else, which is why the project finished.§她对期限**坚定不移**，对其余一切都灵活，这正是项目得以完成的原因。§re（加强）+ solut（松开，同 solve 解决）→ 拿定主意
resolve§Four years of correspondence failed to resolve a dispute that one site visit settled in an afternoon.§四年的往来信件没能**解决**的纠纷，一次实地走访一个下午就了结了。§
resonance§The finding has resonance far outside the field, and nine popular books have now cited it.§这项发现在本领域之外也**引起共鸣**，如今已有九本大众读物引用它。§re（再）+ son（声音，同 sonic 声音的）
